name: Star Map Posters
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: The night sky over any place at any date, as a poster: search a location, pick the moment, choose a theme and shape, toggle constellation lines, grid and cardinal directions - and since v1.7 dress the chart up: FOIL constellation lines in gold, copper, chrome or seven color gradients, a neon GLOW slider, diffraction SPIKES on the brightest stars, real astronomical STAR COLORS, the actual MILKY WAY band computed for your place and moment, and a CONSTELLATION HIGHLIGHT: pick one of the 88 constellations (the birth sign, the favorite) and it shines bold while the rest of the sky steps back. Insert the chart with a classic title, subtitle and date/coordinates text block - all as editable layers. Computed locally from the bundled star catalog. Reopen any chart via Edit Star Map Posters.
